For businesses seeking equipment

Robotics & Automation Sourcing.

The right technology. The right application. Measurable ROI.

Finding the right automation solution should not mean navigating a worldwide equipment market alone. Next Phase Robotics helps businesses define their operational challenges, research suitable technologies, and connect with manufacturers and solution providers. We can explore options beyond our represented product lines.

01 / Understand

Start with the application, throughput goals, site requirements, budget, and operational challenges.

02 / Compare

When suitable alternatives are available, explore Good / Better / Best options with capabilities, indicative costs, installation considerations, and support requirements.

03 / Evaluate

Consider total cost of ownership, labor and productivity assumptions, potential payback, and measurable ROI before deciding.

Equipment availability, pricing, suitability, and potential returns vary by manufacturer and application. Comparisons are based on information available for each opportunity; no particular financial return is guaranteed. Any manufacturer relationships relevant to a recommendation will be disclosed.

Building a great robotic product is only part of the challenge. Finding the right customers, developing sales channels, and opening new markets can be just as demanding.

Next Phase Robotics is an independent, emerging sales and market-development venture. Our approach is selective about the manufacturers we represent and open-minded about the robotics markets we explore. We are developing relationships with manufacturers and commercial buyers to identify where we can create meaningful value.

We bring a relationship-first commercial perspective—not engineering, manufacturing, or systems integration services. We are building our manufacturer network and welcome exploratory conversations.

Explore robotics · Industrial Automation

From production lines to precision handling.

Different robotic systems solve different production challenges. We focus on understanding the commercial application and helping innovative manufacturers reach the right buyers and channel partners.

Where industrial robots are used

CNC machine tending
Welding & fabrication
Assembly & pick-and-place
Packaging & palletizing
Quality inspection
Material handling & sorting

Common industrial robot configurations

Articulated arms

Flexible multi-axis systems for welding, assembly, machine tending, and handling.

Collaborative robots (cobots)

Systems designed for collaborative applications, subject to appropriate risk assessment and safeguards.

SCARA

Fast, precise movement for repetitive assembly and pick-and-place operations.

Cartesian / Gantry

Linear-motion robots suited to machine loading and handling across defined workspaces.

Delta

High-speed picking, sorting, and packaging of lightweight products.

Specialized configurations

Cylindrical, polar, and other purpose-built systems for specific industrial tasks.

Next Phase Robotics focuses on commercial market development and introductions, not robot engineering, installation, programming, or systems integration.

For robotics & automation manufacturers

You've built the technology.
Let's build the business.

A great product does not automatically create a great business. Manufacturers need access to the right customers, credible channel relationships, and commercial leadership that can turn interest into real opportunities.

Next Phase Robotics is being built around focused, relationship-driven representation. We are exploring technologies across multiple industries while seeking a select group of manufacturers where our commercial involvement can make a measurable difference.

For international manufacturers exploring the United States, potential support includes commercial market assessment, strategic account introductions, independent representative and distributor channel development, and relationship-driven sales representation. Engagements are evaluated individually; no existing manufacturer agreements are implied.
